observations: At the root, main builds work_dir/qtensors/<key>.safetensors and passes that value to save_tensor, which joins work_dir a second time.
prepare_env creates work_dir and work_dir/qtensors, but no doubled work_dir/work_dir/qtensors directory.
compile_model reads converted tensors from work_dir/qtensors.
Commit 15 passes qtensors/<key>.safetensors to save_tensor, producing the same work_dir/qtensors destination used by compile_model.
For an absolute intermediate filename, os.path.join discards the earlier work_dir component; the wrong doubled destination is specific to relative work_dir values.
limits: Source inspection and POSIX path reasoning only; no tensor write or conversion ran.
Whether safetensors.save_file creates missing parent directories or fails was not tested, so the old write outcome is unestablished.
